text: Your little girl or boy does not yet understand words, but they understand your tone and your touch. Rifq (gentleness) is tenderness, not weakness—the Prophet ﷺ said: «Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq (Gentle) and loves rifq in all things.» Be patient with their crying in a calm voice.

review_defects.arabic: إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في كل شيء
review_defects.english: Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq (Most Gentle) and loves rifq in all things.
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'رفيق' means 'Gentle', not 'Most Gentle'. Adding the superlative alters the divine attribute as stated in the hadith.
